_comment: LOCAL-ONLY ARTEFACT — a fixture, not a stored record. A reader's worldview profile is computed and held on their own device and NEVER stored server-side. Inferred religious and philosophical belief is special-category data under GDPR Article 9 and, in a number of countries, the kind of record that gets people hurt. This file exists so tools/resonance.mjs has something to demonstrate against. Nothing in the production design writes a file like this to a server.
held: client-side, encrypted at rest, exportable and erasable by the reader alone
derived_from: readings this reader saved, forked, or annotated — never from what they merely opened
